Shell(node -e  import fs from 'fs'; // Extract all wugweb.online URLs from case studies data and map to local paths const cs = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('notion-data/case-studies.json','utf8')); const assetSheet = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('notion-data/asset-sheet.json','utf8')); // Build map of all URLs from case study data with path info const urls = []; for(const c of cs) { for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(c)) { if(typeof v === 'string' && v.startsWith('https://wugweb.online')) { // Extract filename from URL const urlObj = new URL(v); const pathParts = urlObj.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean); // pathname looks like: assets/work/ClientName/filename.mp4 // Remove 'assets' prefix → work/ClientName/filename.mp4 let localPath = pathParts.slice(1).join('/'); // Handle uppercase folder names — Notion sheet uses lowercase const fileName = pathParts.pop(); const folder = pathParts.slice(1).join('/').toLowerCase(); // Try to find in asset sheet const assetMatch = assetSheet.find(a => a['File Name'] && fileName && a['File Name'].toLowerCase() === fileName.toLowerCase() ); if(assetMatch && assetMatch['Relative Path'] && assetMatch['Relative Path'] !== '—') { localPath = assetMatch['Relative Path']; } else { localPath = folder + '/' + fileName; } urls.push({ url: v, path: localPath, key: k }); } } } // Deduplicate const seen = new Set(); const unique = urls.filter(u => { const key = u.path + u.url; if(seen.has(key)) return false; seen.add(key); return true; }); fs.writeFileSync('notion-data/asset-urls.json', JSON.stringify(unique, null, 2)); console.log('Extracted', unique.length, 'unique wugweb.online asset URLs'); console.log('Paths include:', [...new Set(unique.map(u => u.path.split('/')[0]))].join(', '));  2 >& 1)

Shell(node -e  import fs from 'fs'; import path from 'path'; const assets = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('notion-data/asset-sheet.json','utf8')); const active = assets.filter(a => a['Status'] !== 'Reserved' && a['Relative Path'] && a['Relative Path'] !== '—'); async function main() { let ok = 0, fail = 0, skip = 0; for(const a of active) { const localPath = path.resolve('public/assets', a['Relative Path']); const url = 'https://wugweb.online/assets/' + a['Relative Path']; if(fs.existsSync(localPath)) { skip++; continue; } fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(localPath), { recursive: true }); try { const res = await fetch(url, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15000) }); if(!res.ok) { console.log(' HTTP', res.status, url); fail++; continue; } const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer()); fs.writeFileSync(localPath, buf); ok++; if(ok % 10 === 0) console.log(' Downloaded', ok, '/', active.length); } catch(e) { console.log(' FAIL:', url, e.message.substring(0,40)); fail++; } } console.log('\n✅ Done:', ok, 'downloaded,', skip, 'existed,', fail, 'failed'); console.log('Total active assets:', active.length, '| files in public/assets:', fs.readdirSync('public/assets',{recursive:true}).filter(f=>!fs.statSync('public/assets/'+f).isDirectory()).length); } main().catch(e => console.error(e));  2 >& 1)

Shell(node -e  const fs = require('fs'); const env = fs.readFileSync('.env','utf8'); for (const line of env.split('\n')) { const m = line.match(/^([^#=]+)=(.*)$/); if (m) process.env[m[1].trim()] = m[2].trim(); } const { createClient } = require('@sanity/client'); const c = createClient({ projectId:'splvhmk1', dataset:'production', apiVersion:'2024-01-01', token: process.env.SANITY_TOKEN, useCdn:false }); (async () => { const cs = await c.fetch('*[_type=="caseStudy"]{title, "slug": slug.current, thumbnailPath, client}'); const assets = await c.fetch('*[_type=="asset" && usage=="Thumbnail"]{relativePath, sitePath, name}'); const norm = s => (s||'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,''); const noThumb = cs.filter(r => !r.thumbnailPath); let resolvable = 0, unresolvable = []; for (const r of noThumb) { const slugN = norm(r.slug), clientN = norm(r.client); const hit = assets.find(a => { const p = norm(a.relativePath || a.sitePath || ''); const n = norm(a.name || ''); return p.includes(slugN) || n.includes(slugN) || p.includes(clientN) || n.includes(clientN); }); if (hit) resolvable++; else unresolvable.push(r.title); } console.log('no-thumb caseStudies:', noThumb.length); console.log('resolvable via asset fallback:', resolvable); console.log('UNRESOLVABLE (render blank):', unresolvable.length); unresolvable.forEach(t => console.log(' -', t)); })().catch(e => console.error('ERR', e.message)); )

section[1] : body; // Parse blocks: h2, p, ul>li const blocks = []; const h2re = /<h2[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/h2>/g; const pre = /<p[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/p>/g; const ulre = /<ul[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/ul>/g; // walk sequentially const all = []; const h2Matches = [...content.matchAll(h2re)]; const pMatches = [...content.matchAll(pre)]; const ulMatches = [...content.matchAll(ulre)]; h2Matches.forEach(m => all.push({ pos: m.index, type: 'h2', text: strip(m[1]) })); pMatches.forEach(m => all.push({ pos: m.index, type: 'p', text: strip(m[1]) })); ulMatches.forEach(m => { const items = [...m[1].matchAll(/<li[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/li>/g)].map(x => strip(x[1])); all.push({ pos: m.index, type: 'ul', items }); }); all.sort((a, b) => a.pos - b.pos); return all; } function strip(s) { return s.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/ /g, ' ').trim(); } function toPortableText(blocks) { const out = []; for (const b of blocks) { if (b.type === 'h2') { out.push({ _type: 'block', style: 'h2', _key: 'k' + out.length, children: [{ _type: 'span', marks: [], text: b.text }], markDefs: [] }); } else if (b.type === 'p') { out.push({ _type: 'block', style: 'normal', _key: 'k' + out.length, children: [{ _type: 'span', marks: [], text: b.text }], markDefs: [] }); } else if (b.type === 'ul') { for (const item of b.items) { out.push({ _type: 'block', style: 'normal', _key: 'k' + out.length, listItem: 'bullet', level: 1, children: [{ _type: 'span', marks: [], text: item }], markDefs: [] }); } } } return out; } const PAGES = { 'privacy-policy': 'src/pages/privacy-policy.astro', 'refund-policy': 'src/pages/refund-policy.astro', 'terms-of-use': 'src/pages/termsofuse.astro', }; for (const [pageId, file] of Object.entries(PAGES)) { const blocks = parseLegal(file); const pt = toPortableText(blocks); const docId = pageId; await c.patch(docId).set({ body: pt }).commit(); console.log(`seeded ${pageId}: ${pt.length} portable text blocks`); } console.log('DONE'); EOF node /tmp/seed-legal.mjs)
